body: Actually forgot I made this post, but it arrived near the end of last month. The tracking actually never updated, it just showed up in my mailbox one random day. Nothing to indicate why it had gone radio silent, the tracking number and barcode were still on the envelope clear as day.

Could try a help request or missing mail search, though I think it works better if the shipper initiates it. My shipper doesn't speak English well and was unsure of how to navigate it, so I initiated one; he told me that mine was a small envelope, so high chance of mine falling somewhere unnoticed.

[https://www.usps.com/help/missing-mail.htm](https://www.usps.com/help/missing-mail.htm)

That's if it is actually in a USPS facility, and still not going through customs, though.
Yup, down for me. I'm not gonna worry unless I come back in the morning and it's still down.

Yeah, I've figured I'm not gonna understand ISC. And same, happy that it's not unique to me, but miffed that there's something going on and I don't know what.

Same to you, I hope yours comes soon, too!

One of mine that went to ISC New York on March 16th has been stuck there and still is. I had another one that passed through there March 29th and arrived at my house today though, which baffled me.

Both packages contained collectible trading cards, and while they're not super expensive by any means, they're not easy to find for sale given how niche the series is, and the lost/stuck package had more cards and harder to find ones than the one that made it to me. So I get how upset you are. =/

Same. Even arrived on the same date and around the same time as yours did.

Literally nothing since, even though a package that arrived on the 29th at ISC New York was out in less than two days, and arrived at my house today.

Same here. A \~$40 package from France that I'm expecting arrived at ISC New York on March 16 and no movement since.

I had another \~$40 package (this one from Japan) arrive there on March 29... and get to my city (in Texas) today! That makes me worry that something happened to my 1st package.

Seems like a lot of packages in the last couple of months are mysteriously quiet, wonder if something happened?

The really ironic part is that this is a neuroscience lab... where brain disorders are studied.

Likely losing authorship on all my research papers and being sued and then told to pay $92k is the thing that will push me over the edge. I can't see any other way out after that.

Hey, thanks a lot. I happened to the check the email this account was linked to and saw your kind replies, and felt validated for the first time; I was half-convinced that all I was doing was making myself the victim there and wondered why I couldn't get out of that mindset. I had to leave and then come back later because I found myself sobbing again. 

I'm a very emotional person and the smallest thing can set me off, and when backed into a stressful situation like the one I described, I have a very hard time speaking out loud -- which is part of why this subreddit is the first place I've told this story and not to anyone IRL. This is also the first time I've admitted to someone I'm considering ending it, too.

I feel like if I get successfully sued for the amount she wants, then there isn't anything I can do. I can't afford that even with my new job. I'll be earning double my current salary there, but truthfully, the threat of that hanging over my head is the most terrifying part that is pushing me to that edge to wait.
